message: Implement validated account pagination and eager loading in one SELECT.
rationale: An EXISTS filter escapes LIKE metacharacters and uses instr to enforce case-sensitive matching before account pagination. Joined eager loading retrieves every entry, including for previously loaded accounts, without additional SELECTs; dependency pins and models remain unchanged.

files.content:
from sqlalchemy import Column, ForeignKey, Integer, String, func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, joinedload, relationship
class Base(DeclarativeBase): pass
class Account(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'accounts'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String, nullable=False)
    entries = relationship('Entry', order_by='Entry.id')
class Entry(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'entries'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    account_id = Column(ForeignKey('accounts.id'), nullable=False)
    title = Column(String, nullable=False)
def list_accounts(session, term, limit, offset=0):
    for name, value in (('limit', limit), ('offset', offset)):
        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0:
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a nonnegative integer')
    if limit == 0:
        return []

    statement = select(Account)
    if term:
        statement = statement.where(Account.entries.any(
            Entry.title.contains(term, autoescape=True)
            & (func.instr(Entry.title, term) > 0)
        ))
    statement = (
        statement.options(joinedload(Account.entries))
        .order_by(Account.id)
        .offset(offset)
        .limit(limit)
        .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
    )
    accounts = session.execute(statement).unique().scalars().all()
    return [{'id':a.id,'name':a.name,'entries':[{'id':e.id,'title':e.title} for e in a.entries]} for a in accounts]
